name: Jacks Bagels Knysna
address: Shop 22, Knysna Mall, 42 Main Rd, Knysna Central, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: New York-style bagels baked fresh daily in the heart of Knysna Mall.
description_long:
Jack's Bagels brings authentic New York-style bagels to Knysna, baked fresh on-site every day. Located in the Knysna Mall on Main Road, this cheerful spot serves up proper bagels with classic fillings like smoked salmon and cream cheese, pastrami, and egg mayo, alongside decent coffee and a selection of pastries.

The atmosphere is casual and quick-service friendly, perfect for a breakfast on the go or a light lunch while shopping. Everything's made fresh, and you can taste it — the bagels have that proper chewy texture that's hard to find outside the big cities. It's a straightforward, no-fuss operation that does one thing well.

Whether you're a local looking for a reliable breakfast spot or passing through Knysna and craving something other than the usual café fare, Jack's Bagels delivers quality without pretension.
